meta.name: Generative Edit (FLUX 3 Image Klein)
meta.licenseNote: FLUX 3 Image Klein (Black Forest Labs) under its own flux-3-image-klein license; the MLX files are mflux-community's conversion (same licence). Bring your own files; Get AI Models offers them on a Mac.
meta.notes: Runs natively on a Mac (genai-native gn-diffusion flux3-klein/edit on gn-mlx, MLX): Klein's distilled 16-step flow map, the picture as its reference at about 768² (the output takes its aspect), LoRAs unmerged. (generate.expand runs on flux3-klein/fill with AusBoss's Outpaint LoRA instead.) q4 on a 16 GB M1 Air at 512²: about 190 s. On Windows and Linux (CUDA) it runs from BFL's INT8 ComfyUI file with the Qwen3-VL 4B encoder (qir::klein), the 8, 12 and 16 GB profiles' edit when the files are installed; the picture at about 1 MP.
meta.creator: Black Forest Labs · mflux-community
meta.description: Edits by instruction on the GPU: cleaner than MOSS Edit, slower
